_readme: S741, lane 2's cheap piles (2026-11-27). Four El Camino records hold on what their pages print. 19883 (Photography certificate) was read from the Photography A.S. page, which prints no certificate section; Programs of Study lists a 'Photography Certificate of Achievement' page of its own, which this read follows. 31319 (Commercial Music certificate): 19 against the printed 20. 42541 (Business Administration 2.0 AS-T): 27-30 against the printed 28-30. 19857 (Architecture certificate): 33 against the printed 36. total_differs is filed only from a page read (kb/program_total_differs.json). This read prints each page as the capture reads it, so a session can read each list's courses, units and figures and the total line word for word. Five loads, no model call, nothing written.

http_hosts.catalog.elcamino.edu: the registry's catalog address is http://catalog.elcamino.edu/, and the harvest's capture reads every program page at that address, so each filed source and record carries it; this read asks for the same pages as filed

questions.photography_certificate: The address and text of the Photography Certificate of Achievement's own page: its heading, courses with units and total.
questions.figures: Each list's courses with their printed units, each list's printed figure and the total line, word for word.
